method_definitions.Generalist: Uses the generalist role output only.
method_definitions.Fixed role: For each model, selects the single role with highest overall recall on the development packet bank; ties prefer generalist, then qualitative_methods, then domain.
method_definitions.All roles: Counts a flaw as detected when any available role output flags the mapped flaw type.
method_definitions.WarrantRoute: Uses --warrantgate-routes when provided; otherwise falls back to the generalist requested_expertise proxy.

metrics.tp_over_n: true positives over evaluated packet count
metrics.credibility_success_rate: binary LLM-as-Judge success rate, Qiao et al. 2025 definition
metrics.conformability_success_rate: binary LLM-as-Judge success rate, Qiao et al. 2025 definition
